allowed_remediation_scope: Create a new R3 QA execution package and task-local output root.
Correct the QA-PROD-INTEGRATION case-count binding after explicitly deciding whether 48 or 49 is authoritative.
Replace direct execution of non-idempotent historical REM10 and R11 writers with immutable-input, task-local-output wrappers or equivalent read-only compatibility checks.
Make command-result capture sequential or lifecycle-aware so long-running suites return their final exit code and raw report.
Re-run only the remediated fresh-QA manifest after package verification.
forbidden_remediation_scope: Modify existing test files in place.
Modify existing Reviewer packages, Reviewer payloads or transport attestations.
Overwrite or delete historical REM10 or R11 evidence.
Advance A11, Human Exact-Manifest, Bootstrap Human Commit or Migration 320 gates without a new complete deterministic QA result.
Use Git, network, services, databases, seeds or migrations.
decision_note: If a human determines that a new forty-ninth production-integration case is mandatory, that would be a new Candidate and would invalidate Reviewer-payload reuse. The no-Candidate-change branch therefore treats the current 48/48 suite as the frozen subject and remediates the execution binding only.
